segments.text: Ok so this is the sub agents page for Google Antigravity on React Native, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
This is the problem, it talks about a live delegation log, but there's no frontend code for it at all.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
This part, the whole delegation log, wasn't on the page, so I wrote it myself.
Moving on to the demo. With my log added, the three sub agents run and show up, but none of that UI comes from the page.
So basically, the page promises a live log but gives no React Native code for it, and the agent needs httpx, which the install never adds.
So yeah, kindly check this and fix it.
